name: BTC-TVM-1
purpose: Retrospective daily spot trend research, not live trading or guaranteed price prediction
constraints: Rules and checks are recorded before inspecting full historical performance.
No parameter selection after reading holdout; sensitivity results are diagnostic only.
A retrospective holdout is not a genuinely unseen prospective experiment.
Use closed UTC daily candles only; no synthetic fills for missing candles.
Signal from close t executes at open t+2, earning open-to-open returns thereafter.
Holdout begins from cash with all strategies charged their initial entry costs.
Costs apply to actual turnover, including weight drift and a 5 percentage point no-trade band.
Terminal equity is marked to market without forced final liquidation.
Forecast calibration excludes labels whose end timestamps reach the next split.
Confidence intervals use paired circular moving-block bootstrap and do not prove stationarity.
Single-exchange USDT data do not model counterparty risk or USDT/USD basis risk.
